article_title: Tourist plane crashes in Peru, killing 13 on board

tasks.prompt: What is the main event reported in the article?
options: A tourist plane crashed during a sightseeing flight near the Nazca Lines, killing all 13 people on board
Peru closed the Nazca Lines permanently after a storm
A passenger plane made an emergency landing in Lima with no injuries
An archaeological team discovered new drawings in the desert
tasks.correct_answer: A tourist plane crashed during a sightseeing flight near the Nazca Lines, killing all 13 people on board
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדווחת על התרסקות מטוס תיירות במהלך טיסה באזור קווי נסקה ועל מותם של 11 נוסעים ושני אנשי צוות.

tasks.prompt: Who was on board the aircraft?
options: Thirteen passengers and no crew
Eleven passengers and two crew members
Two passengers and eleven pilots
Only firefighters and police officers
tasks.correct_answer: Eleven passengers and two crew members
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הדיווח היו במטוס 11 נוסעים ושני אנשי צוות, ובסך הכול 13 בני אדם.

tasks.prompt: What happened shortly after the aircraft departed from Pisco Airport?
options: It returned safely because of bad weather
It landed beside the Nazca Lines visitor centre
It crashed in the Pueblo Viejo area
It continued to Lima for inspection
tasks.correct_answer: It crashed in the Pueblo Viejo area
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המטוס המריא משדה התעופה בפיסקו והתרסק זמן קצר לאחר מכן באזור פואבלו וייחו.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “wreckage” mean?
options: The planned route of the aircraft
The remains of the badly damaged plane
The passengers’ travel documents
The drawings at the archaeological site
tasks.correct_answer: The remains of the badly damaged plane
tasks.explanation_hebrew: wreckage הוא מה שנשאר מכלי רכב או מטוס לאחר שניזוק או התרסק.

tasks.prompt: The authorities will “assess” the accident. What does “assess” mean here?
options: Celebrate the flight
Hide the damaged aircraft
Examine and evaluate what happened
Cancel every tourist visit to Peru
tasks.explanation_hebrew: assess פירושו לבחון ולהעריך את המצב או את הראיות כדי להבין מה קרה.

tasks.prompt: What does “heartfelt condolences” mean in the municipality’s statement?
options: A formal order to stop flights
Sincere sympathy offered to the victims’ families
A request for tourists to visit the site
A technical explanation of the crash
tasks.correct_answer: Sincere sympathy offered to the victims’ families
tasks.explanation_hebrew: heartfelt condolences הם דברי תנחומים כנים ומכל הלב למשפחות שאיבדו את יקיריהן.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article say the cause should be determined by the relevant aviation authorities rather than guessed immediately? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהסיבה טרם נקבעה ושנדרשת בדיקה מקצועית של הראיות, השרידים ופעולת המטוס לפני הטלת אחריות.
expected_points: The cause was not yet known when the report was published
Specialist authorities must examine evidence from the aircraft and crash site
A formal investigation helps avoid unsupported conclusions and can assign responsibility

tasks.prompt: Write a 70–100 word summary including the flight’s purpose, departure point, crash location, casualties and investigation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול טיסת תיירות מעל קווי נסקה, יציאה מפיסקו, התרסקות בפואבלו וייחו, 13 הרוגים וחקירת רשויות התעופה.
expected_points: The aircraft was carrying tourists to view the Nazca Lines
It departed from Pisco Airport and crashed in the Pueblo Viejo area
Eleven passengers and two crew members died and there were no survivors
Peru’s civil aviation authorities were expected to investigate the cause

tasks.prompt: Explain the difference between “passengers”, “crew members”, “survivors” and “deceased” as these words are used in the report.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להגדיר נוסעים, אנשי צוות, ניצולים ונפטרים, וליישם נכון את המילים על נתוני התאונה.
expected_points: Passengers were the tourists travelling on the aircraft
Crew members were the two people operating or working on the flight
Survivors are people who remain alive after a disaster; the report said there were none
The deceased refers respectfully to the 13 people who died

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining why the Nazca Lines are important to the context of this crash.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שמדובר באתר ארכאולוגי מפורסם של אונסק״ו הנצפה בדרך כלל מן האוויר ושאירעו באזור תאונות תיירות קודמות.
expected_points: The Nazca Lines are a famous archaeological and UNESCO World Heritage site
Their large geoglyphs are commonly viewed from sightseeing aircraft
The flight was connected to tourism at the site
The article notes earlier fatal tourist-plane crashes in the area
